events.text: The sects hold their autumn hunt in the red hills. Every young fighter wants to bring back the biggest stag.

ok.log: You bring it down with one clean strike. Your name is toasted at the fires.

fail.log: The stag outruns you all day. You come back with a rabbit and a story.

effects.log: Pheasants and hares for the whole camp. The cooks love you.

events.text: A wounded boar bursts through the hunters' line, straight at a young disciple.

ok.log: You turn the boar with a palm to the skull. The disciple stares at you like a god.

fail.log: You turn it, and it opens your leg.

effects.log: The boar crashes into a tree. Everyone breathes again.

events.text: Maple leaves fall like red snow on the hunting road.

effects.log: The hunt can wait. The leaves cannot.
You press them in a book. Years later they are still red.

events.text: A rival hunter has been claiming other people's kills.

effects.log: Your fletching is unmistakable. His lies fall apart.

events.text: Bear tracks lead into a ravine, and a hunter's torn cloak lies beside them.

ok.log: You find the hunter alive in a cave, the bear long gone.

fail.log: You find the bear. You leave faster than you came.

effects.log: Together you find him by dusk.

events.text: Around the fire, the hunters sing songs older than any sect.

effects.log: Your ghost story silences the whole camp.

events.text: An old archer offers to teach anyone who can hit a pinecone at fifty paces.

ok.log: The pinecone bursts. He teaches you for a week.

fail.log: Close. He teaches you anyway: pity is a kind of teaching.

effects.log: He never misses. Breath, then release.

events.text: A fur trader offers good silver for pelts from the hunt.

effects.log: The warmest winter of your life.

events.text: The children are not allowed on the hunt, so you hunt the chickens instead.

effects.log: You catch it. It catches you back.

events.text: A tiny shrine where hunters leave the first arrow of the season.

effects.log: The mountain god is pleased, probably.
Names of hunters going back three hundred years.

events.text: A noble's hunting hawk has flown off, and the noble is offering a reward.

ok.log: It lands on your arm. The noble pays well. (+20 taels)

fail.log: It lands on your head. You are in pain but paid a little. (+5 taels)

choices.text: Tell him where you saw it

effects.log: He finds it himself and nods to you.

events.text: The hunt ends with a feast: venison, wine, and too many speeches.

choices.text: Give a speech of your own

effects.log: The best venison you have ever tasted.
